name: Skunkworks
summary: The Skunkworks is a bustling goblin experimental camp tucked within the northern reaches of Silverwind Refuge in Ashenvale. Operated by Venture-minded tinkerers under Horde contract, the site hums with dangerous prototypes and volatile explosives designed to bolster regional military efforts.

sections.title: Gears and Gunpowder
sections.body: Tucked away in the northern section of Silverwind Refuge, the Skunkworks serves as a covert proving ground for volatile goblin engineering. Supervised on-site by Foreman Jinx and driven by Chief Bombgineer Sploder, technicians labor day and night amid ticking gears and chemical fumes. The encampment centers around heavy machinery—including a towering Super Reaper 6000—where experimental armaments are assembled and tested under perilous conditions before being deployed across contested frontiers.

faq.answer: The Skunkworks is a goblin engineering encampment situated within the northern half of Silverwind Refuge in Ashenvale. It acts as an open-air workshop for constructing and testing heavy munitions and machinery.

faq.q: Who leads the operation at the Skunkworks?
faq.answer: Chief Bombgineer Sploder oversees the technical and explosive development from atop a Super Reaper 6000, while Foreman Jinx manages logistical duties and directs operatives working in the area.

faq.q: Why is the Horde using goblin engineering here?
faq.answer: The Horde relies on goblin technical expertise to overcome Alliance resistance and regional wilderness threats throughout Ashenvale, utilizing outsourced inventions to manufacture devastating prototypes like experimental bombs.

angles.text: The Skunkworks displays the peak of chaotic goblin ingenuity, crammed with volatile ordnance and mechanized shredder units that push prototype designs to their absolute limits.
Foreman Jinx coordinates operations here, securing dangerous technical payloads that help shift the brutal balance of power within the contested forests of Ashenvale.
